title: File:Euro banknote shreds.jpg
desc: The shreds were produced by the cross-cut shredder of a banknote processing system BPS M7 from Giesecke+Devrient when destroying euro banknotes (series ES2) of different denominations. The shredder cuts pieces with a typical size of 1.5 x 14 mm². The banknote cannot be reconstructed. A €100 banknote

title: File:20 and 50 Euro banknote straps delivered by G4S.jpg
desc: 200 Euros in 20 Euro notes, and 500 Euros in 50 Euro notes, contained in banknote straps and delivered by G4S’s cash handling and delivery service. The bundle of 20 Euro notes bears the branding of Geldservice Austria (GSA), which presumably packaged the notes for shipping.

title: File:Uncut Strip of 50 Euro Banknotes.jpg
desc: Uncut Strip of 50 Euro Bills on Display at the Monnaie de Paris, France.

title: File:Punched pieces of euro banknotes.jpg
desc: For cancelling banknotes a puncher has cut a pattern of holes into banknotes. This picture shows a collection of punched pieces with a diameter of 12 mm from euro banknotes (series ES2).
